note: Hand-authored micro-agreement excerpts for REVIEWER_APPROVED CKG controls. Not model output. Not production fixtures owned by Claude acceptance suites.

excerpts.syn-a: The Borrower shall not incur any Indebtedness. There are no enumerated exceptions in this micro-agreement.
excerpts.syn-b: The Borrower shall not incur any Indebtedness except Indebtedness under this Agreement.
excerpts.syn-c: Capacity equals the greater of (A) an amount determined by mutual agreement of the Required Lenders in their sole discretion and (B) a percentage of EBITDA selected by the Borrower after consultation with counsel to the Administrative Agent — no numeric formula is stated.
excerpts.syn-d: Indebtedness not exceeding the greater of (A) $25,000,000 and (B) 10.0% of Consolidated EBITDA.
excerpts.syn-e: Indebtedness of Restricted Subsidiaries that are not Loan Parties in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $30,000,000.
excerpts.syn-f: No Liens except (a) Permitted Liens, (b) Liens securing the Obligations, and (c) Liens securing Refinancing Indebtedness thereof.
